// diagnostic

E0310

`T?` used where plain `T` expected

What

`T?` used where plain `T` expected

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Handle or unwrap the optional value before using it as plain `T`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0310: tests/ui/effects/erased_scope_restores_refinement_and_effect_facts.stderr.

Error [jet.OptionalWhereValueExpected]: This needs Int (a whole number), but the value is Int?
  --> tests/ui/effects/erased_scope_restores_refinement_and_effect_facts.jet:15:10
    |
 15 |     need(value)
    |          ^^^^^
 Why: A plain value is required here, not an optional one
 Fix: Test with `== Val(...)` or `== None` first, e.g. `if x == Val(n) { ... }`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0310

Error [jet.EffectBoundExceeded]: `active_effect` uses the effect `FS.Read("missing")`, which its signature doesn't allow
  --> tests/ui/effects/erased_scope_restores_refinement_and_effect_facts.jet:27:23
    |
 27 | active_effect: fn() -[IO]> {
    |                       ^^
 Why: The signature declares `-[IO]>`, so the body may only use those; `FS.Read("missing")` is outside that set
 Fix: Add `FS.Read("missing")` to the effect list, or stop using it in `active_effect`
 Denial: invocation
 Call chain: active_effect
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0740
